fee_notes: Royalty is 10% of Gross Revenues, payable on the 1st and 16th of each month; late fees apply if not paid within 5 days of due date. Local Advertising Expense is 3% of Gross Revenues, paid monthly to advertising suppliers chosen by franchisee. Technology Fee is $380.00 to $500.00 per year (currently $380/year), paid annually — equates to approximately $31.67–$41.67/month. Toll-Free Number Fee is $120.00/year but has never been issued since Bark Busters North America, LLC took over operations. National Conference Fee up to $1,250 per attendee (mandatory attendance). Transfer/Sale Franchise Fee is 15% of Gross Sale Price not to exceed $20,000. Additional Training Fee is $7,500 per trainee. Successor Franchise Fee is $1,000. Liquidated Damages and Non-Compliance Damages are each $50,000 per violation/breach.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty(1) | 10% of Gross Revenues (2). | Payable on the 1st and 16th of each month. | Late fees apply if not paid within 5 days of due date
Local Advertising Expense | 3% of Gross Revenues(2). | Payable monthly to your advertising suppliers as determined by you. | Used for promoting your business in your community including digital advertising and geo-targeting in your Territory.
Toll-Free Number Fee | $120.00 per year. | Annually on the first day of the calendar year. | We reserve the right to increase this fee at any time upon thirty (30) days' notice to you. This fee has never been issued since Bark Busters North America, LLC took over operations.
Technology Fee | $380.00 to $500.00 per year. | Annually. | The price for our currently recommended system is $380.00 per year. We reserve the right to increase this fee at any time upon thirty (30) days' notice to you.
Ongoing Inventory(3, 4) | Varies based on your sales. | Upon delivery.
National Conference Fee(5) | Up to $1,250 per attendee. | Ninety (90) to One Hundred Twenty (120) days before Conference. | Attendance at the National Conference is mandatory.
Local or Regional Seminars, Meetings or Programs | $500 to $2,500 plus an estimated $50 for materials. | As incurred.
Additional Training Fee(6) | $7,500.00 per trainee | Before commencement of training classes.
Successor Franchise Fee | $1,000.00 | Thirty (30) days before your Initial Term expires or you sign a Successor Franchise Agreement.
Transfer / Sale Franchise Fee(7) | 15% of the Gross Sale Price or value of Transfer of Franchise not to exceed $20,000.00. A training fee of $7,500.00 per person is payable by the purchaser.
Addition of Partner/Shareholder/Member to Franchisee(6) | 15% of 50% of Current Value of Business.
Legal Reimbursement Fee(7) | $1,000.00
Additional Assistance(8) | $0.00
Audit(9) | Cost of audit plus 10% interest on understatement.
Indemnification | Will vary under circumstances.
Cost of Enforcement or Defense | Will vary under circumstances.
Liquidated Damages | $50,000.00 for each idea, concept, product, process, or application.
Non-Compliance Damages | $50,000.00 for breach of Franchise Agreement by Franchisee resulting in Termination.
